message: As a busy parent, I often find myself wishing I was more prepared for those unexpected moments that life throws at us. I recently came across a fantastic resource designed just for kids, and I have to say, it felt good to finally be the prepared one for once! It’s all about making sure our little ones know what to do in an emergency, and I’m excited to share it with you. Have you found any helpful tips for teaching kids about preparedness? 🤔
